start_frame: From the leaf heap down the whole length of the long low brick-vaulted passage: Alice a dark back-of-head and shoulder at the very edge of the near foreground, the White Rabbit already small and in profile far down the vault, gloves in his mouth.
end_frame: The same frame with him smaller still, hurrying away on four legs into the lamplit depth; the distance between them has grown inside one unbroken frame.
constraint_honoured: 'Never closer to him than a medium-wide in this scene… he is genuinely far away' — no push-in of any kind, so the distance stays real distance instead of a lens trick.
movement_note: A move toward him would hero the animal and break the character-sheet waiver's cheapest insurance against the uncanny.
